choices: A thread that runs forever without stopping
Two or more threads each holding a resource the other needs, blocking indefinitely
A thread that uses too much memory
A thread that throws an uncaught exception
explanation: Deadlock: Thread A holds lock1 and waits for lock2. Thread B holds lock2 and waits for lock1. Neither can proceed. JVM doesn't automatically resolve deadlocks. Prevention: always acquire locks in a consistent global order.
